comments.author: Laurencio
comments.body: I have nina, she is not good as she looks, for pirates or pirate/privater jobs I think thant osbald, tufan or wolfgang are better but If you have melee skills and dont like galleys nina can come in handy.

comments.author: Nina
comments.body: @Laurencio you are wrong because Nina is really useful, she have serval skills for different situations: melee, cannons or combination between melee and cannons, very good surgeon, she have cat breeding, steering if you need fast turning and wave breakwater for normal navigation to prevent damage from high waves because galley type ships have low wave resistance, she also have mine detection that is combined with steering in the same duty that can be used in sea battle agains mine layers, etc.
